long_biography.plain_text:
A childhood paper route on Long Island became Skolnick's first entrepreneurial venture and taught him persistence and responsibility. He later built businesses spanning residential and commercial property, becoming president and chief executive of BLS Asset Management and managing member of BLS Realty. His work has covered investment, acquisitions and development across residential, commercial and industrial real estate.

After relocating to Miami, Skolnick created Ikonick to bring his interests in cars and visual art into one public-facing collection. The venue presents classic and modern automobiles alongside sculpture and painting, reflecting a collecting practice that extends from historic cars to contemporary supercars. Through the Skolnick Family Charitable Trust, he has supported health, education and cultural causes. At Mount Sinai Medical Center, he served as board chairman.
